listings.name: Sasol Turfloop
listings.current_description: Sasol Turfloop is a fuel station on the R71 at Ga Thoka, Mankweng, open 24 hours and also offering a bakery, coffee shop and convenience store alongside diesel and petrol.

listings.name: Signature Cosmetics Mall of the North
listings.current_description: Signature Cosmetics Mall of the North is a cosmetics retailer inside Mall of the North stocking its own Signature-branded beauty products alongside international brands such as Revlon, Yardley and Bio-Oil.

listings.name: Smile On Dental Polokwane Central
listings.current_description: Smile On Dental Polokwane Central is a family and cosmetic dental practice at Metropolitan Building offering routine cleaning and whitening, dental implants, and orthodontic treatment including clear aligners and braces.

listings.name: Sportsmans Warehouse Thornhill
listings.current_description: Sportsmans Warehouse Thornhill, inside Thornhill Shopping Centre, is a branch of the national sporting goods and outdoor equipment chain, stocking gear for a wide range of sports and outdoor activities.

listings.name: Steers Engen Bendor
listings.current_description: Steers Engen Bendor is a branch of the Steers flame-grilled fast-food chain, serving 100% pure beef burgers, chicken, ribs, hand-cut chips and thick milkshakes at an Engen forecourt in Bendor.

listings.name: Supa-Roof Lebowakgomo
listings.current_description: Supa-Roof Lebowakgomo is a branch of the national Supa-Roof chain, a specialist roofing retailer supplying IBR, corrugated and tile-profile roofing sheeting and accessories from its shop next to Fairplay Hardware.

listings.name: The Crazy Store Thornhill
listings.current_description: The Crazy Store Thornhill, inside Thornhill Shopping Centre, is a branch of the national discount variety store chain, selling household goods, stationery, toys, decor and everyday essentials at low prices.

listings.name: The Fix Paledi Mall
listings.current_description: The Fix Paledi Mall is the Mankweng branch of The Fix, a fast-fashion clothing brand of the Foschini Group aimed at young adults, trading from Shop 69 in Paledi Mall.

listings.name: The Steakshop
listings.current_description: The Steakshop is a family-run butchery in Welgelegen known for quality braai meat and deli products, trading for more than a decade (previously as Vleislapa Welgelegen), with home delivery available.

listings.name: TTS Polokwane (Massey Ferguson dealer)
listings.current_description: TTS Polokwane is a Massey Ferguson tractor dealership in Magna Via, selling new tractors, haymaking equipment, loaders and sprayers, and offering genuine AGCO parts along with workshop or on-farm servicing.

listings.name: Turfloop Printers & Stationary
listings.current_description: Turfloop Printers & Stationary is a printing and stationery shop on University Road in Mankweng, serving University of Limpopo students and the surrounding community with everyday printing and stationery needs.

listings.name: Vodacom Shop Repairs Savannah Mall
listings.current_description: Vodacom Shop Repairs is a Vodacom-branded store and repair centre in Savannah Mall, offering cellphone and contract deals, data and SIM-only plans, insurance, and device repairs, upgrades and SIM swaps.

listings.name: Wackys Polokwane CBD
listings.current_description: Wackys Polokwane CBD is a fried chicken and wings takeaway on Excelsior Street in Polokwane Central, available for in-store collection and via the Uber Eats and Mr D delivery platforms.

listings.name: Wonderland Pre-School & Foundation Phase
listings.current_description: Wonderland Pre-School & Foundation Phase is a Christian-based nursery and pre-primary school in Sterpark, registered in 1980, with around 103 learners and 12 staff covering pre-school through foundation phase education.

listings.name: Woodstuff
listings.current_description: Woodstuff has supplied timber and boards to builders, carpenters and DIY customers across Limpopo since 2009, stocking melamine, veneer, Supawood, chipboard and solid wood alongside cutting, edging and CNC services.

listings.name: Zanna Motors
listings.current_description: Zanna Motors is an automotive repair workshop in Annadale that services and repairs vehicles of all makes and models, and is a member of the Motor Industry Workshop Association (MIWA).

listings.name: ACDC Express
listings.current_description: ACDC Express is a branch of the ACDC electrical and hardware retail chain, based in the Polokwane Lifestyle Centre and supplying tools, cabling and electrical equipment to contractors, electricians and homeowners.

listings.name: Alpha Sand & Stone Plant Hire
listings.current_description: Alpha Sand & Stone Plant Hire has supplied building sand, stone, and TLB and abnormal-lowbed plant hire from its Ladanna yard since 1971, delivering to customers within about 80km of Polokwane.

listings.name: Alzu Feeds Polokwane
listings.current_description: Alzu Feeds Polokwane is a branch of the Alzu Group, stocking animal feeds, salts and minerals for cattle, sheep and horses, along with poultry and pet feed, from its Industria premises.

listings.name: Bidvest Waltons
listings.current_description: Bidvest Waltons is the Thornhill Shopping Centre branch of the national office and stationery retailer, stocking stationery, office furniture, computer consumables, and catering and hygiene supplies for businesses, schools and individuals.

listings.name: Carrol Boyes
listings.current_description: Carrol Boyes is a South African homeware and gifting brand known for sculptural, functional-art metalware and tableware inspired by the human form, with a store in Mall of the North, Bendor.

listings.name: Cash Crusaders
listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders is a South African buy-sell-trade retailer at Savannah Mall, Fauna Park, dealing in new and second-hand electronics, appliances, tools and musical instruments, and also offering pawn and small-loan services.

listings.name: Chicken Licken Fly-Thru
listings.current_description: Chicken Licken Fly-Thru is a drive-through branch of the Chicken Licken fried-chicken chain on Grobler Street in the Polokwane CBD, serving customers well into the evening every day of the week.

listings.name: Coco Affair
listings.current_description: Coco Affair is a coffee shop at Standard Bank Square on Schoeman Street, Polokwane Central, serving breakfasts, light meals, high tea and cakes, with facilities for outside catering, takeaways and functions.

listings.name: College of Africa
listings.current_description: College of Africa is a private higher-education institution in Mankweng offering Council on Higher Education-accredited programmes such as Adult Matric, Matric Rewrite and Matric Upgrade, alongside vocational training including beauty therapy.

listings.name: Designer Pool Covers
listings.current_description: Designer Pool Covers' Superbia branch supplies and installs pool covers and related pool safety products, part of the company's established presence in Limpopo serving pool owners across the region since 2012.

listings.name: Eagle Clothing
listings.current_description: Eagle Clothing is a South African plus-size fashion retailer with a store in Mall of the North, Bendor, stocking men's and women's shirts, jeans and accessories in sizes up to 10XL.

listings.name: Eduan Park Cafe & Bakery
listings.current_description: Eduan Park Cafe & Bakery is a neighbourhood cafe and bakery on Harvey St in Eduan Park, serving fresh baked goods, light meals and everyday convenience items to the local community.

listings.name: Eskulaap Hotel
listings.current_description: Eskulaap Hotel is a hotel and conference venue in Polokwane set on a hectare of landscaped gardens, with an on-site restaurant, swimming pool and conference facilities for up to 120 delegates.

listings.name: FAW Polokwane
listings.current_description: FAW Polokwane, part of the BB Group dealer network, is an authorised FAW dealership in Nirvana selling and servicing a range of FAW commercial trucks, including freight carriers, tippers and truck-tractors.

listings.name: FreshStop at Caltex Ivypark
listings.current_description: FreshStop at Caltex Ivypark is a 24-hour convenience store at the Caltex garage in Ivy Park, stocking snacks, basic groceries, fresh produce and take-away fast food for motorists on the go.

listings.name: Fusion Boutique Hotel
listings.current_description: Fusion Boutique Hotel is a boutique hotel in Polokwane Central with a dedicated wedding venue, offering a 250-seat reception hall plus rooftop and cellar spaces for ceremonies, alongside themed guest suites.

listings.name: Gasoline Alley
listings.current_description: Gasoline Alley is a vehicle service and tyre centre in Superbia, offering tyre repairs and fitment, general vehicle servicing for all makes and models, and the sale of pre-loved used cars.

listings.name: Good Hope Primary School
listings.current_description: Good Hope Primary School is a public, no-fee primary school in Westenburg, Polokwane, teaching Foundation Phase through to Grade 7 to around 1,300 learners with a staff of 35 teachers.

listings.name: House of Plumbing
listings.current_description: House of Plumbing is a plumbing materials merchant in Superbia, Polokwane, supplying plumbing contractors, maintenance plumbers and the public, with products and expertise extending to the civil, mining and engineering markets.

listings.name: John Craig Limpopo Mall
listings.current_description: John Craig's Limpopo Mall store is a menswear outfitter, part of a South African family-owned chain founded in 1947 with around 60 stores nationwide, stocking suits, shirts, denims, footwear and accessories.

listings.name: Laduma Hardware
listings.current_description: Laduma Hardware in Lebowakgomo is part of a hardware chain established in 1996, supplying building materials for home construction and renovation, with a particular focus on doors and aluminium sliding doors.

listings.name: Lebowa Funeral Parlour Mankweng
listings.current_description: Lebowa Funeral Parlour is a funeral services provider offering burial planning, funeral arranging and related event catering; this branch serves the Mankweng community from premises in Makanye, next to Makanye Mall.

listings.name: Lebowakgomo Hospital
listings.current_description: Lebowakgomo Hospital is a public district hospital in Chuenespoort serving the Lepelle-Nkumpi area, providing emergency and casualty care alongside general medical, surgical, paediatric and maternity wards, including neonatal care and C-sections.

listings.name: Limpopo Structures
listings.current_description: Limpopo Structures is a structural steel engineering and manufacturing company based in Ladanna, Polokwane, serving industrial and commercial clients across Limpopo with steel structure design, manufacturing and erection services since 2003.

listings.name: Mediclinic Limpopo
listings.current_description: Mediclinic Limpopo is a private hospital in Hospital Park with 193 beds, offering a 24-hour Emergency Centre alongside specialist surgical and medical care, a Cathlab, CT scanning, pathology and radiology services.

listings.name: Medleb Private Hospital
listings.current_description: Medleb Private Hospital is a private acute-care hospital in Lebowakgomo offering orthopaedic surgery, general and maternity wards, and a 24-hour emergency unit with two operating theatres and an on-site radiology department.

listings.name: NJR Steel Polokwane
listings.current_description: NJR Steel Polokwane is a branch of the national steel and hardware merchant chain, supplying products such as angle iron and structural steel along with cutting, welding, grinding and painting services.

listings.name: Oak Tree Flower Market
listings.current_description: Oak Tree Flower Market is a florist and event-flower supplier on Schoeman Street in Polokwane, offering fresh flower arrangements, wreaths, and bridal and event floral services with delivery and in-store collection.

listings.name: Osieteddies Kleinkindontwikkelingsentrum
listings.current_description: Osieteddies Kleinkindontwikkelingsentrum is an early childhood development centre and pre-school in Sterpark, registered in 2000, covering language, maths, computer skills, science, music, drama, art and physical development activities for young children.

listings.name: P and L Hardware Mankweng
listings.current_description: P and L Hardware Mankweng is a hardware store on Stand 16 supplying building materials, with services including free local delivery, glass cutting, and plan reading and costing for building projects.

listings.name: Pietersburg Motor Centre
listings.current_description: Pietersburg Motor Centre is a multi-brand used-car dealership in Polokwane Central that has traded since opening in July 1997, running three sales floors with a large stock of cars and bakkies.

listings.name: Pietersburg Motor & Diesel Services
listings.current_description: Pietersburg Motor & Diesel Services is a commercial truck, bus, trailer and generator repair workshop on Lood Street in Futura, with some 25 years of experience servicing commercial vehicles across Limpopo.

listings.name: Pizzalito's Tropicana
listings.current_description: Pizzalito's Tropicana is a pizza restaurant in the Ladana Tropicana Centre in Annadale, serving pizza and other meals for dine-in and delivery via platforms including Uber Eats and Mr D Food.

listings.name: Plumblink Polokwane
listings.current_description: Plumblink Polokwane is the Superbia branch of Plumblink, South Africa's largest plumbing, bathroom and kitchenware retailer, part of the Bidvest group, supplying plumbing fixtures and fittings to trade and DIY customers.
